name: Incredible fintech waitlist landing page by getincredible.com
description: A sparse pre-launch landing page built around one oversized rounded hero card with a lime-to-cream gradient, huge tightly-set black headline, and a small pill tag plus black CTA. Below the card the page drops to near-empty white space with a single download CTA and dense fine-print legal text, creating a stark contrast between one bold statement and regulatory small print.
